name: USDA ERS Data API
tagline: USDA Agricultural Resource Management Survey (ARMS) farm finance data via REST and GraphQL
description: USDA Economic Research Service (ERS) Data APIs provide programmatic access to Agricultural Resource Management Survey (ARMS) farm financial and structural data—income statements, balance sheets, government payments, operator household finances, and related variables—by year, state, farm type, and category. Delivered as JSON over REST (and GraphQL) behind api.data.gov API keys. Free self-serve registration; HTTPS required.

auth.details: Free API key via api.data.gov self-serve signup (name + email). Pass as api_key query parameter (as in ERS docs) or X-Api-Key header (api.data.gov standard). DEMO_KEY works for light exploration.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free api.data.gov key; platform default 1,000 requests/hour for registered keys (limits may vary by service). DEMO_KEY much lower.

rate_limits: Default: 1,000 requests/hour per API key across api.data.gov. DEMO_KEY: 30 requests/IP/hour and 50 requests/IP/day. Limits may vary by service; USDA ERS publishes no separate numeric limit.
use_cases: list available ARMS survey years for farm finance data
get farm income statement estimates by year and farm typology
retrieve gross cash farm income by operator age or region
list ARMS report types and variables for balance sheets and debt
query government payment statistics for commercial vs intermediate farms
